description: Count primes in the inclusive range [2,N] using Pritchard's dynamic wheel sieve.

source.reuse: title-only discovery; clean-room algorithm implementation and fixtures

output.meaning: pi(N), the count of primes in [2,N]

algorithm_details.primary: Start with wheel W1={1}, length 2, and p=3. While p^2<=N, extend by rolling the ordered wheel through min(p*length,N), delete p*w in descending wheel order, count p, and select the next wheel element after 1. Extend the final wheel to N and count its members other than 1.
algorithm_details.independent_reference: Test each integer from 2 through N by trial division through its integer square root.
algorithm_details.distinctness: The primary builds and mutates Pritchard's dynamic wheel; the independent reference does not use a sieve.
algorithm_details.primary_complexity: O(N/log(log(N))) ordered-set operations with array-backed next/previous links; O(N) words.
algorithm_details.independent_complexity: O(N*sqrt(N)) modulo operations and O(1) auxiliary space.

workspace.accounting: Two fixed 1,026-entry i32 link arrays occupy 8,208 bytes; cap includes scalar locals, stack alignment, and ABI bookkeeping.
